points.point: Right way to handle a 503 on a status check (a read)
points.sentence: For a read, retry after a delay and stop after a set number of tries.

points.point: Should I send the post again (a write) after a 503
points.sentence: After a write, check first for work that already exists.
A 503 alone does not prove a social platform outage, and it does not rule out a Blotato issue.

verdict.reason: The customer's status check is a read, and this entry gives the read-specific handling (delayed, bounded retry) and says a write needs an existing-work check first, so it answers the question without resending; the entry does not explicitly say "do not resend," so the reply should make that inference clear.
